candidates.name: mcts-select
candidates.law: From an ordered finite child sequence, calculate PUCT score Q+c*P*sqrt(parent visits)/(1+child visits), where Q=0 for unvisited child else total value/visits. Choose the first strict maximum of scores, with source sentinel -999999; return () for empty child list.
candidates.positive_illustrative_claim: Parent visits=4,c=1; A(visits=2,sum=1,prior=1/4) score=2/3; B(visits=0,sum=0,prior=3/4) score=3/2, so choose B. Equal scores above the sentinel keep the earlier child.
candidates.negative_illustrative_claim: Choosing A over B violates scoring; switching source strict > to >= incorrectly changes tied order. The source's -999999 sentinel is not a guarantee for all possible negative scores.

candidates.name: TIME-SCALE-CONVERT
candidates.law: Review variant for validated UTC civil instants and supplied versioned IERS leap-second table: UTC-to-TAI attaches the applicable TAI−UTC offset and preserves explicit leap-second labels. It is not a single fixed-offset equation for all dates, and UT1 requires epoch-dependent DUT1 data. External table access is an island/data dependency, not D2 syntax.
candidates.positive_illustrative_claim: With historical IERS offset 37s valid from 2017-01-01T00:00:00 UTC, that UTC instant maps to 2017-01-01T00:00:37 TAI. Pre-leap 2016-12-31T23:59:59 UTC uses 36s and maps to 2017-01-01T00:00:35 TAI.
candidates.negative_illustrative_claim: Assuming 37s for 2016-12-31T23:59:59 UTC maps it to 00:00:36 TAI instead of 00:00:35; silently discarding 2016-12-31T23:59:60 UTC or conflating UT1−UTC with TAI−UTC violates time-scale semantics.

candidates.name: CRC-UPDATE
candidates.law: Explicit review profile CRC-8/ATM: register width=8, polynomial 0x07, init=0, no input/output reflection or final xor. For each input octet, xor into 8-bit register and shift most significant bit first for 8 rounds, conditionally xor 0x07 on outgoing high bit. Caller may choose other parameters but those variants are NOT proven here.
candidates.positive_illustrative_claim: Independent 8-bit bitwise reference recurrence checks ASCII '123456789' -> CRC 0xF4; empty input with init 0 returns 0x00.
candidates.negative_illustrative_claim: Changing bit orientation, silently using reflected polynomial or including implicit final xor changes the checksum and violates declared CRC-8/ATM profile; do not conflate any CRC transport frame with D2 syntax.
